headline: High Limit unveils 2026 slate: 65 nights, 34 tracks, 21 states
result: 2026 national schedule announced for the series' third season
blurb: Year three of High Limit got a map that looks like a road atlas exploded. Haulers in 21 states, wives in zero of them.

headline: World of Outlaws issues 2026 safety rule package
result: Six-point fuel cell mounts mandatory, carbon fiber floor pans banned, bolted wheel covers required, rear axle ID capped at 1.875 in.
blurb: Fuel cells stay bolted on, feet stay inside the car, and Dzus buttons got their walking papers. Not every rule bulletin is this sensible.

headline: National Sprint Car Hall of Fame names nine-member Class of 2026
result: Jimmy Carr, Steve Chassey, Bob Gregg, Eloy Gutierrez, Allan Holland, Ed Iskenderian, Jerry McClung, Jerry Stone and Bob Westphal selected; inducted May 30, 2026 in Knoxville
blurb: An early Christmas present for Knoxville: nine legends, from TSR wrench Jimmy Carr to cam king Ed Iskenderian. Santa runs a 410, apparently.

headline: USAC rolls out 2026 sprint car and midget rule updates
result: New roll cage clearance, fuel cell mounting, five-shock limit, bolted wheel cover and full-containment seat rules; revised heat race formats
blurb: Five shocks max, two inches of cage over your helmet, and wheel covers that stay put or cost you. Speedway, Indiana did its homework over the winter.

headline: Interstate Batteries replaces Kubota as High Limit title sponsor
result: Multiyear title sponsorship agreement with FloSports
blurb: The tractor folks handed over the keys and the battery folks jumped in. Finally, a series name that will start on a cold March morning.

headline: Gold Cup scraps split fields, returns to full-field three-night format
result: All entrants race all three nights with full series points each night
blurb: Chico said no more half-measures: 50-plus cars, three nights, everybody races everybody. Bring a cooler and a second cooler.

headline: Keith Kunz Motorsports to close after 2026 season
result: KKM to cease operations after Turkey Night (Nov. 27-28); 8 Chili Bowl wins, 11 USAC National Midget titles, 200+ USAC wins
blurb: The finishing school for half the NASCAR garage is closing its doors. Keith calls it semi-retirement, which means he'll still be at a micro track near you.
